stages.name: Nursery / Germination
stages.key_activities: Nursery seed bed preparation, seed treatment with Pseudomonas, gentle morning watering
stages.source: University of Agricultural Sciences, Bangalore (UASB) Package of Practices

stages.name: Tillering
stages.key_activities: Maintain 2-3 cm shallow water level, weed management, apply first top dressing of nitrogen
stages.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR) Hyderabad

stages.name: Panicle Initiation
stages.key_activities: Keep continuous thin water film (3-5 cm), apply second top dressing (potash + remaining N), monitor for stem borer
stages.source: UASB Package of Practices for Kharif Rice

stages.name: Flowering / Heading
stages.key_activities: Ensure no moisture stress during anthesis, scout for brown planthopper and blast symptoms

stages.name: Grain Filling / Dough Stage
stages.key_activities: Alternate wetting and drying, withdraw standing water 10-12 days before anticipated harvest

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.key_activities: Harvest when 85-90% grains turn golden yellow and moisture is below 20%

stages.name: Sowing & Emergence
stages.key_activities: Seed treatment with Trichoderma, ensure proper soil moisture at sowing depth (5 cm)
stages.source: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Ludhiana Wheat Package of Practices

stages.name: Crown Root Initiation (CRI)
stages.key_activities: Most critical first irrigation at 20-25 days; apply first top dressing of Nitrogen
stages.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat & Barley Research (IIWBR) Karnal

stages.name: Tillering
stages.key_activities: Monitor for yellow rust symptoms; check weed growth; weed control if required

stages.name: Jointing / Stem Elongation
stages.key_activities: Second irrigation; apply remaining nitrogen split; scout for aphid colonies

stages.name: Booting & Heading
stages.key_activities: Critical irrigation at flowering; avoid irrigation during strong windy days to prevent lodging

stages.name: Milking & Dough Stage
stages.key_activities: Light irrigation if terminal heat rises above 32°C; check grain plumpness

stages.name: Ripening & Harvest
stages.key_activities: Stop irrigation completely; harvest with combine when moisture is below 12%

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.key_activities: Ensure seed germination, check for cutworm and bird damage, gap filling if required
stages.source: UAS Dharwad / ICAR-IIMR Maize Package of Practices

stages.name: Knee-High Stage (V6-V8)
stages.key_activities: Scout for Fall Armyworm (FAW) in whorls; inter-cultivation/weeding; apply top dressing urea

stages.name: Tasseling & Silking
stages.key_activities: Critical moisture stage: any drought reduces cob fertilization. Maintain optimal soil moisture

stages.name: Grain Filling / Cob Development
stages.key_activities: Check cob kernel development; light irrigation during dry spells; protect from rodent pests

stages.name: Physiological Maturity
stages.key_activities: Look for black layer formation at kernel base; de-husk and dry cobs to 14% moisture
